name: 単位・小数桁と現在値・開始値・目標値の入力パネル
prompt:
Create one faithful Japanese-localized product UI screenshot of the measurement settings panel in the supplied reference. Keep the full bordered panel in a compact horizontal composition close to 3.24:1.

At the top-left inside the panel, show the bold heading 「測定方法」. Directly below, place a compact outlined unit dropdown on the left with a percent glyph, label 「割合」, and down chevron. Align a second dropdown on the far right labeled 「小数なし」 with a down chevron.

Below, arrange three evenly spaced labeled value fields in one row. Left field: label 「現在の値」 and input 「40%」. Center field: label 「開始の値」 followed by a small red required asterisk; input 「10%」. Right field: label 「目標の値」 with a small red required asterisk; input 「100%」. Between the center and right fields, show the small gray two-direction arrow icon from the source.

Use a rounded outer panel boundary and quiet gray outlines for the dropdowns and inputs. Keep labels muted gray, values dark, and preserve the source's three-column field proportions. Use the Japanese mock for exact localized copy and spacing, and the source crop for the hierarchy, percent glyph, required marks, and swap-arrow geometry.

Use Meiryo, with a compact bold heading, regular field labels, and readable values. No extra controls, helper copy, open menus, or surrounding page chrome. Crisp Japanese glyphs; keep the whole panel within the frame without blank bands.
reviewNotes: Japanese copy, values, required marks, unit, decimals, and swap icon are present; candidate is 2241x702 (3.192:1), close to the 813x253 source crop (3.213:1) and 680x210 mock (3.238:1). The decimal selector is incorrectly outlined; both references show plain text with a chevron. Exact typography and icon metrics remain unverified.
